request.query: polynomial length l1 coefficient norm product submultiplicativity

items.name: Finset.nnnorm_prod_le
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_4} {α : Type u_5} [inst : NormedCommRing α] [NormOneClass α] (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → α),
  ‖∏ i ∈ s, f i‖₊ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖₊

items.name: List.nnnorm_prod_le
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : SeminormedRing α] [NormOneClass α] (l : List α), ‖l.prod‖₊ ≤ (List.map nnnorm l).prod

items.name: Multipliable.norm
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : SeminormedCommRing E] [NormMulClass E] [NormOneClass E] {f : α → E},

items.name: Polynomial.coeff_mul
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p q : Polynomial R) (n : ℕ),
  (p * q).coeff n = ∑ x ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, p.coeff x.1 * q.coeff x.2
